news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹12.20 (vs ₹6.12 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹12.20 (up from ₹6.12 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹357.9m (up 171% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹35.4m (up 99% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 9.9% (down from 13% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses.
